name: Personal Finances
description: Cash-on-hand vs obligations, bills with autopay escalation, urgency-sorted deadlines, append-only payment history, an ACTION-PLAN.md checklist, loans and income — local-only snapshot, no SaaS.

sections.title: Priority Alerts
sections.data: alerts[] (hand-written) + auto alerts from bills[] and deadlines[] (overdue, ≤3d urgent, ≤7d warn, autopay escalation)

sections.title: Deadlines
sections.data: deadlines[] → urgency-sorted table (most overdue first), autopay badges

sections.title: Current Holdings
sections.data: holdings.accounts[] + compare[] → cash vs obligation bars

sections.title: Bills & Amounts Due
sections.data: bills[] → status table (Overdue/Due/Paid/Autopay) + autopay escalation badge (calm → ≤7d → ≤3d pulsing)

sections.title: Payment History
sections.data: history[] → append-only log, newest first (npm run fin:history)

blogPost: A private finances dashboard you fully control (local, no SaaS)
